results.question: How did Mike Johnson become Speaker of the House?
results.answer:
Following Kevin McCarthy’s removal as speaker, House Republicans struggled to find a replacement. Several candidates failed to garner enough support due to internal divisions. As the process stretched on, the House remained paralyzed.

Amidst the chaos, Mike Johnson emerged as a consensus candidate. His relatively short tenure and low profile meant he had few enemies. Johnson’s staunchly conservative views and gentle personal style appealed to the far right, and on October 25, 2023, he was elected the 56th speaker of the House. As speaker, Johnson presides over debates, appoints committee members, establishes the legislative agenda, and maintains order within the House.

results.answer:
Mike Johnson, shaped by his evangelical Christian faith, holds staunchly conservative views. As a lawyer, he defended Louisiana's ban on same-sex marriage and aided officials who opposed the Supreme Court's decision recognizing same-sex marriage. In the Louisiana House, he authored the Marriage and Conscience Act, which critics said could allow discrimination against same-sex couples, and legislation banning "dismemberment abortion".

In Congress, Johnson has a conservative voting record. He served on House committees, including the judiciary, armed services, and natural resources. He also chaired the Republican Study Committee.
